tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// tshe sgrub zhag bdun ma'i nyams len gyi rim pa 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud len zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༈ /swasti/ bde ldan padmo'i nags rum nas// 'chi med bung ba 'od dpag med// deng 'dir thugs rje'i 'phur lding gis// byin nas phan bde'i sbrang rtsi stsol// bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i sgo nas tshe'i dngos grub sgrub par 'dod pa'i tho rengs bya khwa ta'i skad ma grags pa'i dus la sogs par bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs kyis 'dug la/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lan gsum gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang tshad med bzhi bsgom/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar padma dmar po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba de'i steng du bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog padma rā ga ltar dmar zhing gsal la dwangs pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod dang*/ 'dzum zhing zhi ba yid du 'ong ba'i zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba'i bar na baiḍūrya'i lhung bzed 'chi med bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ dbu skra bung ba ltar nag pa'i ral pa'i phyed thor cog gi tshul du spyi bor bcings shing lhag ma lan bur gyur pa zhabs kyi rting pa'i bar du slebs pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs dang dar dmar po'i stod g.yogs dang lhab lhub kyis brgyan pa/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mngon sum bzhin bzhugs par bsam/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arya a pa ri mi ta a yurdzñā na sa pā ri wa ra arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ nas/ shabda pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo= sogs nas/ phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas mchod cing bstod/ bcom ldan 'das la mos gus drag po dung pa dang bcas pas/ oṃ badzra a yu ṣe

sa ra ha ka ra re sha ra re hūm̐ phaṭa zer ba yang snang sa ra he/ sha ra re ka ra re hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ de rjes rang gi sna bug nas rlung ro lan gsum bus/ de rjes sna bug g.yon nas rlung cung zad phyir bus pa'i tshe/ rang gi sna rtse nas rlung spos ring gi du ba lta bu sngo bun ne song bas bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag gi lhung bzed bdud rtsis gang ba'i nang du song bas 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun de la 'khril ba'i tshul du kya mer gyis babs pas/ rang gi khas rngub pa'i tshul du byas pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar po de kha nas mar chil gyis zhugs lus thams cad mer gyis gang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad sangs kyis dag nas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsam nas/ the tshom med pa gal che'o/ /rlung bum pa can ci nus 'dzin/ de ltar lan lnga'am/ bcu'am bco lnga'am nyi shu nas brgya'i bar ci 'grub bya/ rjes dmigs pa sngar ltar byed cing*/ ngag tu oṃ a ma ra ṇi dzi wanti ye swā hā/ zhes brgya stong la sogs pa bzlas/ yang sngar bzhin mchod bstod byas pas/ mdun gyi bcom ldan 'das 'od zer dmar po'i tshul du zhu ste/ rang la thim pas bdag nyid tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med par lam gyis gyur pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig dmar po la gzungs ring gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros lus thams cad gang bas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par gyur par bsam la/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te= sogs gzungs ring nyer gcig bzlas/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /tshe dpag med mgon 'grub gyur nas// sogs nas/ sa la 'god par shog /ces sogs bsngo ba smon lam bya/ 'di la brten nas tshe sgrub zhag bdun byed par 'dod pas lo gsar zla ba sogs kyi yar ngo'i tshes gcig sogs gza' skar gang bzang nas zhag bdun gyi bar la mtshams shin tu dam par bcad/

dmar skyur ma 'dres pa/ zas dkar gsum mngar gsum/ rdor dkar dang nyin tshad bzhag gung tshig ma yol bar/ zhog re bzhin khrus bya zhing*/ grub na gso sbyong gi sdom pa blang zhing tsha bzhes yan la thun gcig tsha bzhes grol nas gung tshig yan la thun gcig bya/ thun la nyams su len tshul sngar ltar bya zhing*/ de yang rlung sbyor dang sngags spel mar byed pa 'dod pas/ rlung lnga bcu nas brgya man ci rigs dang*/ sngags stong nas khri man ci 'grub bzlas/ gzungs ring kyang thun rer nyer gcig nas brgya'i bar ci 'grub bzlas/ mthar bsngo ba smon lam sogs sngar ltar mtshungs/ nyin phyed man sher snying sogs bzlog pa bsrung 'khor kho na la 'bad/ nub mo gnyid du 'gro khar nub phyogs bde ba can la sngas gtad de seṅge'i nyal stabs kyis nyal la/ rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod par gnyid log pas/ rmi lam du sku mthong ba/ gsung thos pa sogs dang*/ nyi zla 'char ba/ sgra gcan las grol ba/ nam langs pa dang lhung bzed bum pa sogs snod dkar gsum gyis gang ba/ tsha tshā dkar pos lung pa kheng pa sogs dge ba'i ltas du ma dang*/ khyad par tshe lo 'di tsam thub ces pa lung bstan nges pa can dang*/ srog chags/ phreng ba/ shing thog zan ril/ sba snyug tshig can/ dpe shog nya ga la sogs pa'i tshe 'di tsam thub pa'i grangs ston pa'i brda'i rnam pa mtha' yas pa gcig 'ong bas de dag shin tu gsang bar bya/ gal te lung bstan ma byung na slar yang zhag bdun skyar bas nges par 'byung ba yin no// de ltar zhag bdun ma'i dus dang rgyun gyi nyams len gyi tshe yang tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa'i smra bcad dam po dang the tshom med pa'i yid ches khyad par can gyi sgo nas 'bad rtsol gyis nyams su blangs pas ji ltar bshad pa bzhin 'byung ba ni nyams su myong bas grub pa yin no// 'phags yul grub dbang padma'i ngang tshul gang*// gangs can 'di na rong ston chos kyi rje// rje btsun dam pa'i thugs bcud bdud rtsi'i rgyun// rgyun chad med par bla ma'i drin las thob// gang 'dir ris med bstan pa'i sbyin bdag che// nor 'dzin skyong ba ngag dbang mtshan can gyi// rgyun gyi nyams bzhes tshul du bkod pa ni// shākya'i btsun pa blo gsal ming can no// a yu puṇye wardha ku ru//
//par 'di shrī nā lend+ra'i chos grwar bzhugs so// //sarba dza ghaṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
